scripts.db:migrate: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter fj-solutions-backend exec prisma migrate dev --schema=../../database/schema.prisma
scripts.db:studio: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter fj-solutions-backend exec prisma studio --schema=../../database/schema.prisma
scripts.db:generate: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter fj-solutions-backend exec prisma generate --schema=../../database/schema.prisma
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:contracts && pnpm --filter fj-solutions-admin exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter fj-solutions-web exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter fj-solutions-backend exec tsc --noEmit
